steps.title: Compare the internal credential register against the state DOI/NIPR system
sop: Pull the sample of licensed employees from the credential register.
Look up each employee's status on the state DOI portal or NIPR.
Record the comparison result per employee.
Done when every sampled employee has a recorded comparison result.
verify: Spot-check 5 comparison results against the source systems directly.
Pass when all 5 match the recorded result.

steps.title: Identify and document discrepancies in license number, status, or expiration
sop: Review the comparison results for mismatches.
Document the specific field and nature of each discrepancy.
Log the discrepancy in the reconciliation tracker.
Done when every mismatch is documented in the tracker.
verify: Review the tracker for mismatches missing documentation.
Pass when none are missing documentation.

steps.title: Correct discrepancies in the internal register
sop: Open the register record with the documented discrepancy.
Apply the correction based on the state-system source of truth.
Save the corrected record.
Done when every documented discrepancy is corrected in the register.
verify: Re-pull the corrected records and compare against the state system.
Pass when all corrected records now match.

steps.title: Note the resolution and correction date for each discrepancy
sop: Update the reconciliation tracker with the resolution taken.
Enter the correction date.
Confirm the resolution note is complete.
Done when every discrepancy shows a resolution and correction date.
verify: Review the tracker for discrepancies missing a resolution note.
Pass when none are missing a resolution note.

steps.title: Confirm the reconciliation is complete and signed off
sop: Review the full reconciliation tracker for completeness.
Confirm every entry shows a resolution and correction date.
Sign off on the completed reconciliation.
Done when the reconciliation is signed off before the audit deadline.
verify: Check for the sign-off entry and date on the tracker.
Pass when the sign-off is present before the deadline.

steps.title: Archive the reconciliation results for audit evidence
sop: Export the completed reconciliation tracker.
File the export in the licensing evidence folder.
Confirm the filed export is retrievable.
Done when the reconciliation results are archived and retrievable.
verify: Retrieve the archived export and confirm it matches the signed-off tracker.
Pass when the retrieved copy matches exactly.
